name: KGNode
title: Knowledge graph: node
description: One typed node of a knowledge-graph document. Its instance fields are an instance of the logical model of its class (see definedBy), e.g. KGPublication for a publication.

element.definition: One typed node of a knowledge-graph document. Its instance fields are an instance of the logical model of its class (see definedBy), e.g. KGPublication for a publication.
IRI, unique within the document.
The node's class.
Human-readable name. Required so a retrieved node reads without resolving it.
Canonical URL of the logical model giving this node's instance shape.
Instance fields, as declared by the class's logical model.
derived | inferred | decided.
Why it is what it is. Required unless derived.
Where it came from. Required unless derived.
Id of a flag raised while extracting this node.
Skill id that produced this node.
